name: lt.topimones/registry
title: TOP Įmonės - Lithuanian company registry (beta)
description: Lithuanian company register data for AI agents: identity, tax, insolvency, procurement. No key.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve a name, a national id, a public id "CC:id", a VAT number or an LEI to up to 10 candidate entities (register identity only), each with its coverage tier and its public id ("LT:110053842"). Pass the two parts as country and id to get_entity and get_entity_history, the whole id to get_entity_series. Name pages carry meta.next_cursor; 200 candidates are reachable per query. An LEI needs no country (it is unique worldwide). Costs one identity disclosure per candidate; an id or identifier with no match counts one miss.

q.description: A name (words of 3+ characters, any case, diacritics optional), a national id, a public id "CC:id", a VAT number or an LEI.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required unless q is a full public id "CC:id" or an LEI (an LEI is unique worldwide).

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor of the previous page, with the same q and country.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: The register identity of one entity by exact id (country + the national id, the part after "LT:" of a public id; resolve_entity finds it from a name), plus the enriched blocks asked for in include: financials, workforce, tax, debt, insolvency, procurement, score. A block is null when it is not asked for, not collected, not licensed or outside the entity's coverage tier; meta.withheld names the reason. An id outside coverage answers not_in_coverage, which does not mean the entity does not exist. With as_of=YYYY-MM-DD, the name, legal form and status valid on that date (null with unknown_for_date where no history covers it); enriched blocks are not dated in this version. Costs one identity disclosure, plus one detail disclosure when an enriched block is served.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case (e.g. "LT").

id.description: National id as issued by the register (the part after "CC:" of a public id).

include.description: Blocks to return besides identity (always returned). Default: identity only.

detail.description: concise: the newest year of each yearly block (tax: also the last full year when the newest is the running, partial year); full: every year held.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the identity valid on that date, as we know it now. Not after today in the country's calendar; today = omitted.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: To find one entity from a name or an id use resolve_entity; this lists many. Identity rows of entities matching filters: name words, legal form, status and registration window on the register; score_risk and vat_registered where the country has them and their source is licensed. A narrowing filter is required (a name word, or a legal form or status - not every status - with a registration window of whole calendar years, at most 5). Up to 20 rows a page, 200 per filter set, no totals; person-like legal forms are never listed. Costs one identity disclosure per row, plus one detail disclosure per row (at least one) with score_risk; an empty page with no next cursor counts one miss. legal_form also takes the common national abbreviation of a form. Identity filters all run before paging, so a page of identity filters is empty only at the end of the matches.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case (e.g. "LT").

name.description: Name words (3+ characters each, any case, diacritics optional).

legal_form.description: Legal forms: national labels or ISO 20275 ELF codes, as lookup_code kind=legal_form lists them, or the common national abbreviation of a form (lookup_code kind=legal_form with q set to it shows the form it names).

registered_from.description: Registered on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Without name it must be 1 January of a year (YYYY-01-01).

registered_to.description: Registered on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Without name it must be 31 December (YYYY-12-31), at most 5 calendar years after registered_from.

score_risk.description: Enriched filter: published score risk level. Costs one detail disclosure per row.

vat_registered.description: Enriched filter: registered VAT payer now (true) or not / unknown (false).

page_size.description: Rows per page, 1-20 (at most 10 with an enriched filter).

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor of the previous page, with the same filters.

tools.name: get_entity_series
tools.description: Use it for values over several periods; for the current state of one entity, get_entity. Numbers over time for 1-5 entities given as whole public ids ("LT:110053842"): revenue, net_profit or tax_paid per year, insured or avg_wage per month, between from and to (at most 12 years or 24 months). A series whose source has no confirmed licence is null with not_licensed. Wages are withheld under the small-cell floor and where two months would isolate a few people. Costs one detail disclosure per entity served; an id outside coverage or without a published profile counts one miss.

series.description: revenue, net_profit and tax_paid are yearly; insured and avg_wage are monthly.

from.description: First period, inclusive: YYYY for grain year, YYYY-MM for grain month.

to.description: Last period, inclusive. At most 12 years or 24 months after from.

grain.description: Must match the series: year or month.

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Use it for every period of an attribute; for the identity on one date, get_entity with as_of is simpler. The periods of the name, legal form and status of one entity (country + the national id, the part after "LT:" of a public id): each value with the day it was first observed (valid_from) and the day it was replaced (valid_to, exclusive; null = current). History starts at the first register load that recorded the attribute; before it the attribute is unknown (meta.withheld: unknown_for_date). Oldest first, at most 100 periods per page. An id outside coverage answers not_in_coverage, which does not mean the entity does not exist. Costs one identity disclosure.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case (e.g. "LT").

id.description: National id as issued by the register (the part after "CC:" of a public id).

attributes.description: Attributes whose periods to return. Default: all three.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only periods still valid on or after this date.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only periods that started on or before this date.

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor of the previous page, with the same parameters.

tools.name: lookup_code
tools.description: The values the filters accept, per country: legal forms (ISO 20275 ELF code and national label; q also finds a common national abbreviation of the form) and register statuses (platform status and the national labels it maps from), every value a page at a time (meta.next_cursor). kind=activity is not served yet: its source has no confirmed licence, so it answers no rows with meta.withheld not_licensed. Costs one call only.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case (e.g. "LT").

q.description: Words, a code or a code prefix. Required for activity; without it legal_form and status list every value, a page at a time.

cursor.description: legal_form and status: meta.next_cursor of the previous page, with the same kind, country and q. Not for activity.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: For one country: every data domain with its sources (licence, licence status, cadence, last successful run) and whether it is served or why not; the last completed register load; servable entity counts by coverage tier and status, rounded to hundreds. Your remaining daily usage is in meta.usage. Costs one call only.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case (e.g. "LT").
